title: International Teaching & Learning Conference 2027

about: Call for abstracts for UNISA's International Teaching & Learning Conference 2027, 3-6 May 2027 in Pretoria. Participants register on the portal before submitting; abstracts are due 31 January 2027 at 23:59 SAST, with full papers for a Progressio special edition due 30 June 2027.
